purpose: Recover algorithmic mechanisms from historical Janus-Demiurge releases without promoting article prose or heuristic performance claims to complexity-theoretic evidence.

historical_anchors.commit_message: v7.2.0: Meta-mode with EXPLORE/EXPLOIT/SURVIVE/CHAOS/HUNT, inertia, hunger, anti-collapse and self-stabilization

EVOLUTIONARY_MEMORY.historical_role: Persist successful and failed configuration experience, maintain elite/best state and adapt exploration strategy.
EVOLUTIONARY_MEMORY.c025_recovery: Use only as a search prior over candidate proof representations and as a graveyard of failed fingerprints; never as a truth oracle.

HYBRID_SAT_PROPOSER.c025_recovery: Admit only as a witness/pivot/structure proposer. A returned assignment must be checked independently against the raw CNF. No UNSAT claim may originate from this lane.

NP_TASK_GENERATOR_AND_CHECKER.historical_role: Random 3-SAT generation, phase-transition ratio 4.26, direct assignment checker.
NP_TASK_GENERATOR_AND_CHECKER.c025_recovery: Useful as a benchmark producer and independent SAT-witness checker only; random phase-transition instances are not worst-case complexity evidence.

ADAPTIVE_TIMEOUT.historical_role: Predict/derive timeouts from prior solution history and observed scaling.
ADAPTIVE_TIMEOUT.c025_recovery: Engineering scheduler only. Timeout selection, censoring and successful-run history are excluded from the proof complexity ledger.

c025_recovery.EXPLOIT: revisit verified exact primitives with nearby structural contexts
c025_recovery.HUNT: prioritize unresolved exact gates and counterexamples
c025_recovery.SURVIVE: fail closed and roll back to the last independently verified checkpoint
c025_recovery.CHAOS: bounded proposer diversification only; randomness never certifies a claim

PARTIAL_SOLUTION_MEMORY.c025_recovery: Store exact proof/representation fragments with explicit interface contracts. Recombination is a proposal until exact replay verifies the composed semantics.

SEPARATE_VERIFIER_IDEA.historical_limitation: Historical Verifier was heuristic/fallback and explicitly not a real universal verifier; it could return generic scores such as 0.5.
SEPARATE_VERIFIER_IDEA.c025_recovery: Replace scoring verifier with deterministic proof-object verification against canonical raw-CNF semantics. Verification must not call the proposer/synthesizer.

COMPRESSION_AS_SEARCH_SIGNAL.historical_limitation: Compression was zlib over string serialization and had no semantic preservation guarantee.
COMPRESSION_AS_SEARCH_SIGNAL.c025_recovery: Promote only exact semantic compression: smaller explicit/latent representation is useful iff an independent certificate reconstructs or proves equivalence to the exact original relation/state.

COUNTERFACTUAL_GENERATION.historical_limitation: Counterfactuals were stochastic and could train on model predictions as pseudo-labels.
COUNTERFACTUAL_GENERATION.c025_recovery: Repurpose as an adversarial generator that searches for exact counterexamples to candidate algebra/representation claims. Counterexamples must be verified directly, never pseudo-labeled.

PHYSARUM_PATH_MEMORY.historical_role: Flow-based path memory and guided architecture mutation over neural-network weights, not a SAT solver.
PHYSARUM_PATH_MEMORY.c025_recovery: Optional search-order heuristic for incidence/pivot regions only. It has zero authority over SAT/UNSAT or polynomiality.

forensic_findings.ARTICLE_LAYER_MIXING: The historical article described the hybrid solver as if janus_genesis/agent.py, task generation and the surrounding world/controller formed one SAT layer. Exact commit archaeology separates them into generator/checker, heuristic solver, adaptive scheduler and meta-controller.

HISTORICAL_SOLVER_VERIFICATION_DEBT.finding: genesis_protocol.py trusted the boolean solved returned by agent.solve_np_task and did not independently call NPTask.check_solution on the returned assignment.
HISTORICAL_SOLVER_VERIFICATION_DEBT.termination_note: The normal early weighted-success condition is consistent with all positive-weight clauses being satisfied, but the timeout tail compared weighted fitness with n_clauses, mixing two scales.
HISTORICAL_SOLVER_VERIFICATION_DEBT.consequence: Historical timing/scaling logs are engineering evidence only and must not be imported as exact SAT correctness or complexity evidence without replaying raw instances and returned assignments through an independent checker.

forensic_findings.RANDOM_3SAT_SCALING_DEBT: Success on random phase-transition 3-SAT, even at large n or with favorable fitted curves, does not establish worst-case polynomial complexity. Adaptive timeouts and success-conditioned histories can further bias scaling fits.

recovered_architecture_for_c025.name: DUAL_POPULATION_PROPOSER_VERIFIER_SPIRAL
pipeline: ADVERSARY_SWARM mutates instances/contexts/certificates to find counterexamples or resource explosions
RESOURCE_LEDGER measures discovery, representation, certificate, verification, state volume and progress steps
JOURNAL stores both surviving and falsified candidates with fingerprints

connection_to_current_B_TO_A_program.historical_hunt_to_current: target unresolved representation walls rather than benchmark score

next_gate_interaction.rule: Recovered heuristic mechanisms may prioritize candidate factors/pivots, but the first implementation remains bound by a preregistered exact grammar and a frozen non-PHP holdout. Heuristics cannot alter the grammar after holdout exposure.
